events.title: Oasis' 'Definitely Maybe' Released

angles.copy: A tribute to the King of Rock and Roll, Elvis Presley. His music lives on.

angles.name: Jimi Hendrix Tribute
angles.copy: Remembering the guitar genius who redefined rock music. His influence is still felt today.
